title: Check GeometryEditor for same undefined elements pattern
body: GeometryEditor.tsx accesses geo.elements.points, geo.elements.graphs, etc. directly (lines 45, 54, 65, 77, etc.). If a stored QuestionGeometryBlock predates the elements field, it would crash the same way. Apply the same fix: provide a default elements object when destructuring block.geometry.
rationale: Same root cause as the AxisEditor bug — legacy blocks stored before elements field was added will crash GeometryEditor too.
